notes: A white-and-blue concept sports car on a show stand; the board behind reads 'BMW VIS...', 'FREUDE...', 'JOY DEFINES T...' and technical data, and the front plate carries a 'Vision' script. history.change: acceptable "BMW Vision EfficientDynamics" (aliases "BMW Vision", pattern "\bvision\b", requires_text "Vision") became two entries: "BMW Vision" (pattern "^(?:bmw )?vision(?: concept)?(?: car)?$", requires_text "Vision") and "BMW Vision EfficientDynamics" (pattern "efficient ?dynamics", requires_text "EfficientDynamics")
history.reason: The notes say the concept's full name needs every word read, and the scorer's brand check (M7) requires it too, but "\bvision\b" with requires_text "Vision" made "BMW Vision EfficientDynamics" label-good when only "Vision" was read; its correct drop (EfficientDynamics not transcribed) counted as two clean drops (M4) in the round-2 blind run. The full name is now good only when "EfficientDynamics" is read.
